title: Before a fix lane starts for a red CI case, the start path names any open PR that already touches it
why: A fix lane can start for a red case that an open or already released PR has fixed, which costs a duplicate lane and a PR to close.
note: Coordinator, 03:35 CST Nov 9. Incident: at 02:52 CST the coordinator started lane brief-destructive-git-windows for a red main, but #2390, already released, had fixed it with Windows proof; the result was a duplicate lane and #2407. Fix: the coordinator's lane-start path searches open PRs for the failing case names and the failing file, and names each PR that already touches them. Home: the lane picks it, perhaps the session-tiers lane-start tooling.
